ruling: R-F packed margins; line L5; gate G5 and prediction G5b
quantizer_identity_meaning: same TurboQuant tables as the dense quantizer (quant.py _tables, rotation seed kv_head*1337+42, 4-bit Lloyd-Max codebook), keys stored as packed 4-bit codes plus fp32 norms by ApaSpq1Workspace (fmt tq4), bulk scores from the ordered packed-r2 arithmetic (spq4 gqa_path r2 -> apa_spq1_run, partition carry)

procedure.sp2_registration: /mnt/ForgeRealm/Project-Tensor/artifacts/apa_sp2/registration.json (read-only; absent from this worktree because *.json is git-ignored)
procedure.targets: every SP2 G2 target with bits=4: eq_b4_<shape id> for the 32 registered shapes (16 per D), from apa_sp2_common.targets(reg)[0]
procedure.query_rows: as SP2: decode uses its one row; prefill samples floor(linspace(0,L-1,min(32,L))) (data(..., sample=True))
procedure.keys: tc.quantize_sp2_keys(tc.tensor(k), 4, storage='packed') -> PackedSpKeys (Build B, arm B)
procedure.bulk_scores: each sampled query row i as one L=1 decode call: tc._spo2.packed_run(q[:,:,i:i+1,:], k, v, packed._packed_tuple(), float(float32(1/sqrt(D))), 0.0, False, None, False, fmt='tq4', carry='partition', dump=True, gqa_path='r2')[2] (the bulk-score buffer the selection reads; delta does not change it). The public wrapper is not used here because it needs the table being measured and does not return bulk scores.
procedure.exact_target: as SP2: FP64 dot of the FP32 q and K rows times float(float32(1/sqrt(D)))
procedure.valid_scores: as SP2: causal classes keep key j < S - L + i + 1 for sampled query index i; non-causal keep all S keys
procedure.statistic: maximum_over_all_registered_G2_valid_scores (SP2's), pooled per D over the 16 shapes of that D
procedure.freeze: create-only artifacts/apa_p1d/packed_e_q_table.json and packed_e_q_table.sha256 after all 32 targets PASS; the sha is then pinned in tensor_cuda/tensor_cuda/apa_packed.py (PACKED_TABLE_SHA256) and the table is loaded only through PackedRegisteredMargins.load
procedure.expected_count_reason: same queries, keys and validity rule as the dense table's 4-bit entries (production e_q_table.json count 13,762,608 per entry)
procedure.instrument_pin: not the statistic: for the first two sampled queries of every head and the first/last 17 keys, the dumped bulk must equal an FP64 recomputation (q @ R[kh]^T) . codebook[codes] * norm * scale within 1e-4 + 1e-5*|value|; a miss is an instrument failure (repair at most 3 times, recorded)
procedure.no_reselection: the table is a measurement; nothing is re-selected after any quality result

procedure_pins.note: apa_sp2_gpu.py carries this round's one-line storage="dense" edit at its quantizer call; data() and stats() are unchanged

prediction_G5b.statement: each packed e_q is within 1% (relative) of the dense table's entry for the same (4, D), because quantization error dominates both
prediction_G5b.consequence: reported HELD or NOT HELD; a miss changes no code and the lead rules before the next round

line: forge-gpu-run --min 30 --max 1800 --label p1d-L5 -- timeout 1750s env APA_P1D_ARM_B=<staged arm B> python3 -B scripts/apa_p1d_gpu.py l5 --out artifacts/apa_p1d/gpu/L5 --max-seconds 1500 (resumable: targets with a PASS receipt are skipped; rerun unchanged until none remain), then CPU: python3 -B scripts/apa_p1d_gpu.py l5-freeze
scope_note: kernel sweep; this establishes nothing about model quality
